verification.notes: TIMELINE ANALYSIS: Evidence shows SU-BTT (Egyptian govt Dassault Falcon 7X) visited Wilmington as early as June 2021 while Dassault facility was still operating. The suspicious element is the Egyptian plane's visits BEFORE Satys arrival. CLAIM INTERPRETATION: The speaker appears to conflate two issues: (1) Satys's legitimacy as a company (it IS legitimate), and (2) whether the Egyptian planes' Delaware visits were truly for maintenance (questionable given timing). Marking as MIXED because Satys is legitimate but the broader implication about suspicious activity has some evidentiary support.
